Level 1 of 5
Themed

Campaigns share a look or a tagline, but not an idea.

MKB runs well-produced campaigns that look alike, but each one argues something different, so none of them builds on the last.

  1. 1Themed

Why this level

The same visual system and sign-off appear across paid social, email and the website, but the message changes with each campaign. Nothing links one campaign's idea to the next.

To reach level 2

Choose one idea for the next launch and carry it, not only the look, into every channel that launch touches. Each piece should restate the same claim in its own format.

Confidence

Medium. Based on 3 campaigns found across 4 channels in the last 12 months.
